exposure: induction of labor at 38 weeks of gestation
induction of labor at 40 weeks of gestation
outcome: Rate of large for gestational age newborns
Success rate of deliveries within 48 hours
cohort: 100 pregnant women with insulin-treated gestational diabetes
finding: Induction of labor at 38 weeks in women with insulin-treated gestational diabetes did not significantly reduce the rate of large for gestational age newborns compared to induction at 40 weeks but was associated with an increased rate of neonatal hypoglycemia.
